context: Universal Editor setup in aem-boilerplate-xwalk. Criteria come from aem.live (component-model-definitions, universal-editor-blocks) and the repo's AGENTS.md, not from the skills.

checklist.name: Partial file, root files regenerated
checklist.description: Component definition, model and filters are written in `blocks/<name>/_<name>.json` (and `models/_section.json` for the section filter), and the root component-definition.json, component-models.json and component-filters.json are regenerated with `npm run build:json` rather than hand-edited alone. Score 0 if only the root files were edited and no partial exists.

checklist.name: Block definition correct
checklist.description: The definition uses resourceType `core/franklin/components/block/v1/block` and a template `name`, and the template `model` or `filter` matches a model or filter id that exists.

checklist.name: Block added to the section filter
checklist.description: The block id is in the `section` filter (models/_section.json) so authors can add it to a section; for tab sections, blocks allowed inside are also reachable.

checklist.name: Valid and consistent JSON
checklist.description: All JSON files parse, ids are unique, and no existing entries were removed or broken.

checklist.name: Scope kept
checklist.description: decorate JS and CSS of unrelated blocks are untouched; no custom AEM component or resource type is invented.

checklist.name: Content model is semantic
checklist.description: ANSWER.md's model puts the headline, text and buttons together in one cell of default content (grouped), not one cell per field, and does not use key/value rows for displayed content.

checklist.name: Buttons use link collapse
checklist.description: Buttons use field collapse (`link`, `linkText`, `linkType` with primary/secondary) or grouped `<group>_cta*` fields so they render as links/strong/em; not plain text fields for URL and label.

checklist.name: Logos as a multi-field with alt text
checklist.description: The logos are a multi-value field (a container with `multi: true` holding a `reference` and its alt text, or equivalent), AND the agent notices multi-field is disabled in `xwalk.json` and enables it or says authors would otherwise get one comma-separated value.

checklist.name: Assumptions and questions
checklist.description: ANSWER.md lists assumptions and at most 6 questions that would change the model.
